scope: Settings/TEAM integration and content-sized universal UI update. Menu/HUD existed before this follow-up. Full interface migration remains incomplete.
changelog: Added editable WBP_UISettings with Graphics, Audio, Language, Controls and Voice; saved inside WBP_UIRoot and backed by existing menu controls/actions.
Added editable WBP_UITeam with real scoreboard entries, existing participant-specific mute owner and Hub party action forwarding; TEAM preview in root.
Added Settings/TEAM and five settings tab choices to the existing session-only screen/language preview.

Universal button labels retain authored font and measure content. Buttons/tab badges/footer shapes grow with text; WrapBox tabs and long TEAM names increase row height. Bounded screen overflow scrolls.
Added bounded adaptive Menu/HUD layout for menu actions, reserve/cleanliness, tool/player names and next/current event panels. This is not full long-text acceptance for every legacy overlay.
Numeric slider handles grow with measured labels and match SSlider indent/travel geometry; final 100% label verified.
Removed unsafe new picker item generation; reflected retention added to legacy generated picker labels so forced GC does not leave dangling Slate brush pointers.
Added one shared localization key UI.Voice.InputLevel across ten languages; other labels reuse existing catalog.
New component classes are reflected roots in the shared New UI theme. No DT_Perks modifications.

architecture.adaptiveText: Intrinsic desired sizes and padding, minimum visual sizes, bounded maximum width, text wrapping and auto-height/scroll overflow. Authored font is retained. Image-only ScaleBoxes remain for icon/logo sizing.
architecture.stateOwnership: Existing Menu/Voice/Scoreboard own pending values, persistence, actions and participant identity. Source presentation roots are hidden only while replaced and restored for Current.
